rationale: One original frozen-target conditional remains under-mixed in PA tails after a valid same-kernel continuation reached its 300s budget. Retain that failure; add a full-period PA proposal rather than relax diagnostics or redraw theta.
selection: Only conditional cases still failed after extensions_01; preserve all four outer targets and every old chain
kernel: Fixed mixture: 30% original Student-t independence, 30% local joint Gaussian, 15% calibration random walk, 25% full-period uniform PA plus correlated conditional 4D Student-t independence; exact per-kernel Hastings corrections
posterior: Unchanged p(nuisance|same frozen neural theta, same validation measurement), same physical priors and full correlated likelihood
acceptance: Same all-five-nuisance plus PA sine/cosine rank/folded Rhat <1.01, bulk/tail ESS >=400; otherwise withhold predictive conclusions
phase_handling: Start from saved current states; changed proposal is a new homogeneous phase with 500 declared equilibration steps. Diagnose retained new-phase draws alone. Never relabel or discard previous failures.
retries: One bounded proposal repair, no score-driven seed retries or model changes
